note: A leg may only report not_run when it is registered here AND the recomputed unavailability codes it names still hold on the committed graph. The set of codes is compared both ways: a code the gate computes but does not register, or a registered code that is no longer true, makes the leg run instead. review_by is an expiry: scripts/verify-ci-leg-receipts.mjs fails once it has passed.
